canonical_project: China Mobile Guizhou / Guiyang Big Data Center, Gui'an New Area
notes: China Mobile's Guizhou/Guiyang big-data center is described as one of China Mobile's major cross-provincial data centers and a national disaster recovery center; reported scale includes about 19 ha/275 mu planning, 19,000 sqm building area, 21,000 racks and 320,000-server capacity.
